definition: Needle localization is a clinical technique that uses imaging and a needle-guided marker or wire to identify a target for a subsequent procedure.
entry_text: Needle localization is a clinical technique that uses imaging and a needle-guided marker or wire to identify a target for a subsequent procedure.
example: A specialist marks a nonpalpable breast lesion for the surgical team.
label: Needle localization
sense_note: Distinguish preoperative localization from diagnostic biopsy.
